title: Insurance claim file
description: Supporting document contract normalized from DocuBricks.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: insurance-claim-file
  title: Insurance claim file
  description: Supporting document contract normalized from DocuBricks; it is not rendered as a form.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: insurance_insurance_claim_file_v1
    sourcePath: Schemas/insurance/insurance_claim_file
    sourceVersion: insurance_insurance_claim_file_v1
spec:
  documentType: insurance_claim_file
  fields:
    - id: claim-number
      name: claim_number
      label: Claim number
      description: Claim number or file identifier.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_claim.claim_number
    - id: policy-number
      name: policy_number
      label: Policy number
      dataType: string
      required: true
      ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_policy.policy_number
    - id: insured-name
      name: insured_name
      label: Insured name
      dataType: string
      ontologyPropertyRef: insured_party.insured_name
    - id: claimant-name
      name: claimant_name
      label: Claimant name
      dataType: string
      ontologyPropertyRef: insured_party.claimant_name
    - id: loss-date
      name: loss_date
      label: Loss date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_date
    - id: loss-description
      name: loss_description
      label: Loss description
      dataType: string
      ontologyPropertyRef: loss_event.loss_description
    - id: claim-status
      name: claim_status
      label: Claim status
      dataType: string
      ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_claim.claim_status
    - id: reserve-amount
      name: reserve_amount
      label: Reserve amount
      dataType: number
      ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_claim.reserve_amount
    - id: paid-amount
      name: paid_amount
      label: Paid amount
      dataType: number
      ontologyPropertyRef: insurance_claim.paid_amount
    - id: coverage-position
      name: coverage_position
      label: Coverage position
      dataType: string
      ontologyPropertyRef: coverage.coverage_position
  sections:
    - id: document-details
      title: Document details
      fieldIds: [claim-number, loss-description, claim-status]
    - id: policy-and-parties
      title: Policy and parties
      fieldIds: [policy-number, insured-name, claimant-name]
    - id: loss-and-financials
      title: Loss and financials
      fieldIds: [loss-date, reserve-amount, paid-amount, coverage-position]
  validationRules:
    - id: claim-number-present
      severity: error
      description: Claim number is required.
      supported: true
      rule:
        op: present
        field: claim_number
    - id: reserve-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: Reserve amount should be non-negative when present.
      supported: true
      rule:
        op: gte
        left: { field: reserve_amount }
        right: { value: 0 }
  reviewPolicy:
    lowConfidenceAction: human-review
  outputSchema: {}
  inertSourceMetadata:
    promptId: prompt_v1.txt
    modelRoutingId: model_routing.json
